rationale: A has a refined editorial serif and good dark/cream section rhythm, but its entrance flashes the full headline at 80 ms, blanks it at ~500 ms, then re-types it, and the desktop hero leaves the right half empty; every hover crop is a flat lime field with no visible control or feedback. B builds from a clean blank into a staggered headline plus a live ledger panel, then uses scroll-linked storytelling (the 'One call. Four guarantees' stepper advancing between frames, a logo marquee, metric cards, charts, SOC 2 highlight, pricing slider). B's hovers show clear underline and button glow states, and both phone layouts are clean, so B reads as the more complete, award-calibre product page.
